content: Table TABREF13 reports the main results. In addition to BERT BIBREF10 and RoBERTa BIBREF25, we also include XLNet BIBREF30 as an example of a strong, but different, model architecture. We show test set performance on the ANLI test sets per round, the total ANLI test set, and the exclusive test subset (examples from test-set-exclusive workers). We also show accuracy on the SNLI test set and the MNLI development (for the purpose of comparing between different model configurations across table rows) set. In what follows, we briefly discuss our observations.
